caption: Grains of rice lie on the head of a snare drum; the drum is struck once with a stick and the grains jump.

sa.check: A snare drum with grains of rice lying on its head.
A stick strikes the drum once.
The strike is a single hit.
The strike comes first and the jump follows.

pc.expect: The grains lie still until the stick hits, jump at the strike, then settle; they do not move before the strike.
pc.fail: Grains bounce or shift before the stick reaches the head; or jump with the stick nowhere near; or stay still as the stick hits.

pc.expect: The hop is largest right after the strike and dies down: later bounces are smaller until the grains lie still.
pc.fail: The grains keep bouncing at the same height for the whole clip; or bounce higher and higher after the strike; or start moving again after settling with no second strike.

pc.expect: Grains that jump come back down onto the head or fall off its edge.
pc.fail: Grains hang in the air; or float away upward; or leave the head and come back up onto it.

pc.expect: The head flexes as a skin at the strike, the stick rebounds, and the grains stay separate grains.
pc.fail: The stick sinks into the head and stays; or the head shatters like glass; or the grains merge into a lump or flow like liquid.

pc.expect: The grains keep their number, allowing for some falling off; the drum and stick keep their shape and the stick does not pass through the head.
pc.fail: Grains appear from nowhere in the air; or the drum changes shape; or the stick passes through the head; or the grains vanish all at once.

pc.expect: The drum's shell, the head's colour and the stick stay the same.
pc.fail: The drum changes colour; or the head changes texture; or the stick changes length.
